sections.heading: About Me
items: **Age:** 16 years old
**Experience:** 6 years of full-stack Roblox development
Experienced in building complete Roblox systems, including server architecture, UI, DataStores, frameworks, and everything in between.

items: Full-stack Roblox development
Server-side systems and architecture
UI development
DataStore and persistent-data systems
Framework-based development
Codebase restructuring and complete rewrites
Performance optimization
Writing clean, organized, and maintainable code
Building systems that are easy for other developers to understand and extend

sections.heading: Coding Practices
items: Clean and consistent code structure
Readable code that is easy to understand and modify
Clear comments focused on useful context and complex behavior
Code designed to be understandable for junior developers
Code structured so senior developers can easily extend existing systems
Strong focus on maintainability rather than simply making something work
Performance and optimization are considered throughout development
Comfortable completely rewriting systems when an existing codebase requires it
